# WebMD

> > WebMD provides comprehensive, evidence-based health information, medical news, and wellness guidance across hundreds of diseases, conditions, and health topics.

WebMD is a leading online health information platform offering detailed health centers for major medical conditions, symptom guides, treatment options, and medical education resources. The site serves as a trusted reference for patients seeking reliable health information, disease education, and wellness guidance across cardiology, oncology, mental health, respiratory, autoimmune, and numerous other medical specialties.

## Key Topics

- Cardiovascular Diseases
- Type 2 Diabetes
- Type 1 Diabetes
- Breast Cancer
- Rheumatoid Arthritis
- Depression
- Asthma
- Atrial Fibrillation
- Lupus
- Eczema
- Allergies
- Mental Health Disorders
- Symptoms & Diagnosis
- Treatment Options
- Disease Education

## Cardiovascular & Circulatory Health

- [Heart Disease Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/heart-disease/default.htm): Heart disease health center with cardiovascular condition information.
- [Hypertension (High Blood Pressure) Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/hypertension-high-blood-pressure/default.htm): Hypertension health center with blood pressure management information.
- [Atrial Fibrillation (AFib) Center](https://www.webmd.com/heart-disease/atrial-fibrillation/default.htm): AFib center with information on symptoms, causes, and cardiac treatments.
- [Deep Vein Thrombosis (DVT) Center](https://www.webmd.com/dvt/default.htm): DVT health center with blood clot condition information and diagnosis.

## Chronic Disease Management

- [Diabetes Center](https://www.webmd.com/diabetes/default.htm): Diabetes center covering Type 1, Type 2, and gestational diabetes.
- [Lung Disease & Respiratory Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/lung/default.htm): Lung disease center covering COPD, asthma, pneumonia, and respiratory health.
- [Arthritis and Joint Pain Center](https://www.webmd.com/arthritis/default.htm): Arthritis and joint pain center with rheumatoid arthritis and osteoarthritis info.
- [Crohn's Disease Center](https://www.webmd.com/ibd-crohns-disease/crohns-disease/default.htm): Crohn's disease center with inflammatory bowel disease information.

## Cancer & Oncology

- [Oncology Center](https://www.webmd.com/cancer/default.htm): Cancer center with information on types, treatments, and chemotherapy.
- [Breast Cancer Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/breast-cancer/default.htm): Breast cancer health center covering diagnosis, treatment, and survival rates.

## Mental Health & Neurological Conditions

- [Mental Health Disorders Center](https://www.webmd.com/mental-health/default.htm): Mental health disorders center with condition types and treatment overview.
- [Depression Center](https://www.webmd.com/depression/default.htm): Depression health center with symptoms, medications, and therapy information.
- [ADD and ADHD Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/add-adhd/default.htm): ADHD health center with information on symptoms, diagnosis, and treatments.

## Allergies, Autoimmune & Skin Conditions

- [Allergies Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/allergies/default.htm): Allergies health center covering symptoms, treatment, and allergy types.
- [Lupus Center](https://www.webmd.com/lupus/default.htm): Lupus health center with autoimmune disease information and treatment.
- [Eczema & Atopic Dermatitis Center](https://www.webmd.com/skin-problems-and-treatments/eczema/default.htm): Eczema and atopic dermatitis center with treatment and symptom information.

## Infectious Diseases & Other Conditions

- [HIV/AIDS Health Center](https://www.webmd.com/hiv-aids/default.htm): HIV/AIDS health center with transmission, prevention, and treatment info.
- [Eye Care Center](https://www.webmd.com/eye-health/default.htm): Eye health center covering LASIK, cataracts, glaucoma, and vision care.

## Health Reference & Navigation

- [WebMD Homepage](https://www.webmd.com): WebMD homepage with health information, medical news, and wellness guides.
- [All Health Topics A-to-Z Guide](https://www.webmd.com/a-to-z-guides/health-topics): A-to-Z directory of health topics and medical conditions reference guide.
